# Investment strategies

iShares exchange traded funds (ETFs) do more than you think. To start, see how they can help you build a foundation for your portfolio with long-term investment strategies, or go further by tapping into timely events and trends in the global market.

## Choose your strategy

## Investing for retirement with target date ETFs [...] Mega forces are long-term, transformative forces that can change the trajectory of the global economy by shifting the priorities of societies, driving innovation and redefining business models.

Demographic divergence

Aging populations in major economies are poised to limit how much countries can produce and grow. By contrast, selected emerging market economies can benefit from younger populations and growing middle classes.

Digital disruption and artificial intelligence (Al) [...] Access

Gain access to a wide range of bonds through the simplicity of an ETF and benefit from multi-sector diversification, such as U.S. Treasuries, corporate bonds, and municipal bonds.

Value

Seek to enhance your portfolio with diversified and cost-efficient ETFs designed to balance stability, income generation, and long-term growth.

Easy to use

You can invest in an ETF for less than $100, while mutual funds often ask you to invest at least $1,000. A share of stock can range in price from a few dollars to several thousand dollars. Mutual funds and ETFs can be wise long-term investments; since they both invest in many companies, risk is spread out and you’re exposed to a wider range of asset allocation.

## How to invest with BlackRock [...] Investing is a long-term venture. Short-term profits are elusive – and often illusory. The longer investment horizon you’re willing to cultivate, the better chance you will have to realize extended annualized returns on your investments. [...] Popular investment options today include stocks, bonds, mutual funds and ETFs, which are all registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

To learn about the net asset and issuance flows of mutual funds and ETFs, visit the Investment Company Institute.
